label_semantics: One axis-aligned box per image on the whole net, class `Volleyball Net`. Inspected on a seeded sample of 12 frames at full resolution: the top edge sits on the net's top tape; the left and right edges sit on the net's vertical side bands (over the sidelines), not on the posts — inside each post by roughly 0.035-0.04 of the frame width in this camera; the bottom edge at the net's bottom band. The posts, antennas and referee stand are outside the box. Our corner labels run post to post, so these boxes are systematically narrower than ours at the sides.

near_duplicate.note: Set just under the lowest similarity of any synthetic copy in the calibration (10% brightening, 0.9969; a 0.5% shift, 0.9973; JPEG q30, crops of 5-10% and resizes at or above 0.9999). The build refuses a threshold that misses a calibrated copy. With one fixed camera, frames at or above it differ by a few pixels of player movement and are dropped as redundant; frames inspected just below it (0.9962, 0.9950, 0.9930) are distinct moments of play.

groups.event: FIVB Beach Volleyball World Tour, Olsztyn Grand Slam (Poland), centre court; one fixed ground-level camera behind an end line, two slightly different framings. Year not established from the images; the source file name's 2016_01_04 is a file timestamp, not the event.
groups.evidence: Boards on the frames read OLSZTYN GRAND SLAM, WARMIA MAZURY, GALERIA WARMINSKA, ORLEN / GLOWNY SPONSOR REPREZENTACJI POLSKI and FIVB WORLD TOUR; the file names are frames of two videos, 2016_01_04-09_07-4797.mp4 (619 images, 489 frame numbers, 130 numbers twice from two different passes) and f.mp4 (15). Same court, stands and camera in every frame inspected (12 seeded, all 15 f.mp4, 6 pairs).

provenance.note: Net boxes only (class `Volleyball Net` -> `net`; Player and Volleyball dropped). Boxes, not corners: the box runs between the net's side bands, inside the posts, so its sides are narrower than our post-to-post corner labels; its top edge is the tape. Every eligible image is one camera at one event (FIVB Olsztyn Grand Slam, centre court): one recording group's worth of net geometry, however many frames. Train only, never validation, model selection or test. Selection, exclusions and hashes: manifest.json; audit: audit.json.
